title: Composite Analyst
why_fit: GIPS composite oversight is control-and-data work like my Northrop model audits; 2+ years preferred and I have no performance-measurement experience yet.
why_us: Wellington's Composite Team owns the control framework behind GIPS composite reports, which is the kind of accuracy-first work I like. At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and at AMG Family Dental I built the reconciliation and reporting process that recovered $500K+ in annual revenue. I want to apply that habit of checking data against its source to composite membership, benchmark changes and client guideline changes, and to learn performance measurement from a team that serves as the firm's subject matter expert.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Composite Analyst role on Wellington's Composite Team. The job is to keep composite construction, membership and GIPS Composite Reports accurate and well controlled, and that is close to the work I have done in finance and controls roles.

At Northrop Grumman I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls. Reviewing a model means tracing every number back to its source and documenting where it does not tie, which is the same discipline needed to review composite membership, benchmark changes and client guideline changes before they reach a report.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont I run financial operations, including billing, collections and revenue tracking. I found and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue by improving reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix, and I automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation in Python, cutting the work from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. I also produce budget-versus-actual variance analysis for ownership each month, so I am comfortable working with data under a deadline.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance from Brandeis and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk, with coursework in corporate finance, econometrics and statistics. I do not yet have hands-on GIPS or performance measurement experience, and the posting prefers two years in that field. I would learn the standards and the firm's investment strategies quickly, and I would bring a careful, documentation-first approach to the team's control environment.

I am based in the Boston area, a US citizen, and available immediately. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
